text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said Tuesday it and Physio-Control Holding Corp entered an alliance to create technological compatibility between their cardiology and monitoring products and to develop a joint distribution strategy.

The alliance will allow emergency medical teams equipped with Physio-Control portable heart monitor/defibrillator with 12-lead capability to capture an electrocardiogram from a suspected heart attack victim.
From there, it can immediately send the waveforms to the Marquette MUSE CV cardiovascular information system installed at the hospital.

Physio-Control, based in Redmond, Wash., manufactures and sells a broad range of defibrillator/monitor/pacemakers. Marquette Medical manufactures medical electronics equipment, software and systems for diagnostic cardiology and patient monitoring.
